Market / Community — Bodoland, Assam

Bodoland Farmers’ Market

Location
Bodoland, Assam
Category
Market / Community
Design role
Ola Magdy, Principal Associate Designer
Practice
Archohm

Overview

A concept for a market as a shared community destination. Three connected circular spaces accommodate trade and gathering, with covered edges and open courts expressing the relationship between local exchange and public life.

01

Three circles of activity

The form-development study brings exchange, gathering and celebration into an interconnected plan.
